correctness.rationale: Routh–Hurwitz verifies stability uniformly on h>0,k≥0. Exact symmetric Lyapunov elimination reconstructs stationary covariance, antisymmetric current and the EPR rational function, with the symbolic checker confirming identities in formal h,k. Strict positivity of h²−h+k+2 and of the Routh determinant reduces the entire parameter-space classification to one affine sign; a second exact difference factor proves the unique baseline crossing. The two-copy statement follows from orthogonal Laplacian modes and invariance of independent unit noise. No numerical experiment is used to infer an all-parameter result.
